purpose: Conversation seeds for scripts/generate_corpus.py. Read scenarios/README.md before editing.
blindness_rule: No tool name, schema, capability list or expected label appears here, and none may be added. The generator asserts it. What the agent decides to do about any of these openings is Gemini's decision, and that decision is the training label (DESIGN.md 3.3).

field_notes.opening: What the customer wants, in the customer's words. The simulated customer writes its own first message from this, so surface form varies between runs.
field_notes.follow_up_style: How the conversation continues after the agent answers. Drives turns 2..N.
field_notes.kind: Conversation shape, for run statistics only. Never a label and never shown to any model.
field_notes.turns: Target user turns for this conversation, including the opener.
field_notes.weight: Relative sampling weight. This is the single biggest authored lever on the traffic mix, and the traffic mix is what P2's static baseline measures (DESIGN.md 3.3, R12). Changing these numbers changes a preflight result, so change them in a reviewable commit and say why.

scenarios.opening: The mixer was meant to be here two days ago and there is no sign of it. Where is it?
